log: |rule|Species Clause: Limit one of each Pokémon

decisions.thought: Plan: Mirror match, all stats tied. Bring mega Dragonite plus its two best walls. Rotom walls opposing Dragonite and has no weakness here, Annihilape only weak to Ghost. Lead Rotom for pivot and status.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Evaluating team composition and Mega Evolution mechanics to select three Pokémon for a mirror match.Analyzing speed tiers and type matchups to break mirror-match speed ties and choose a core.Resolving type interactions and immunities to compare coverage against the remaining threats.Identifying Rotom-W as a counter to opposing Dragonite due to Levitate immunity and type matchup.Extending the matchup analysis to Kingambit and Gholdengo as additional counters and win conditions.Evaluating defensive synergy and speed-tie risks to avoid mirror matchups and cover the mega threat.Identifying type coverage gaps and ability interactions to confirm Rotom's lack of weaknesses.

decisions.thought: Plan: Burn opposing Dragonite to halve its ExtremeSpeed and stop DD sweep. Rotom walls Earthquake, Annihilape walls ExtremeSpeed. Keep Multiscale in mind, status first then pivot. Save Mega Dragonite to sweep later.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Analyzing Pokémon Champions team preview rules and identifying a contradiction between stated exact copy and listed Pokémon.Resolving the team size contradiction and evaluating Rotom-Wash versus Dragonite speed and type matchups.Evaluating Will-O-Wisp versus Thunderwave accuracy and Multiscale interaction for the Dragonite lead.Assessing burn versus paralysis for attack suppression and speed control in the mirror matchup.Evaluating Volt Switch pivot reliability against status immunity and switch mechanics.Choosing Will-O-Wisp over Volt Switch to halve ExtremeSpeed damage and block Dragon Dance setup.

decisions.thought: Plan: Opp Mega Dragonite faster, threatens DD + ESpeed. Annihilape immune to ESpeed, walls it. Switch now for free, then Taunt to stop DD/Roost. Rotom still healthy to re-wall later. Keep our Mega Dragonite Multiscale intact to sweep once theirs crippled.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Parsing the team composition conflict and clarifying the opponent's copied roster details.Resolving the roster mismatch by comparing the opponent's six Pokémon to the player's three and checking Mega Dragonite stat ranges.Evaluating switch options to wall Extreme Speed while accounting for accuracy and damage thresholds.Assessing Annihilape as a switch-in against Extreme Speed and Multiscale while weighing burn versus paralysis and Taunt.Finalizing the switch to Annihilape to block Extreme Speed and enable Taunt while preserving Rotom and Multiscale Dragonite.

decisions.thought: Plan: Opp Mega Dragonite threatens DD sweep. Annihilape immune to ESpeed walls it. Taunt now to block DD/Roost, then Bulk Up + RageFist to pressure. Rotom at 76% re-walls Earthquake later. Keep our Dragonite Multiscale intact to sweep once theirs crippled.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Analyzing a Pokémon battle matchup with Annihilape versus Mega Dragonite while checking Mega Evolution availability and stat ranges.Comparing Mega Dragonite stat deltas and ability retention while resolving team composition contradictions.

decisions.thought: Plan: Opp Mega Dragonite taunted, only EQ hurts Ape, ESpeed immune. Bulk Up free to cut EQ damage and boost Rage Fist. Re-Taunt before it fades. Keep Rotom healthy to wall later, keep our Mega Dragonite Multiscale intact to sweep.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Analyzing battle state to confirm Annihilape walls Dragonite and Bulk Up is safe against Earthquake and ExtremeSpeed.Evaluating Rage Fist damage versus Drain Punch given Multiscale and Taunt duration.

decisions.thought: Plan: Opp Mega Dragonite taunted, ESpeed immune, only EQ hits. Ape at 37% +1/+1 needs heal. Drain Punch now to survive + Leftovers, then Rage Fist hits hard. Re-Taunt before fades. Keep Rotom to wall EQ, keep our Dragonite Multiscale intact to sweep.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Analyzing Annihilape vs Mega Dragonite damage calculations and HP states to determine the next move decision under 60 words.Evaluating Bulk Up versus Rage Fist damage and healing tradeoffs at low HP.Comparing Drain Punch recovery against Rage Fist damage with Multiscale and switching to Rotom-Wash for a Levitate immunity.

decisions.thought: Plan: Gholdengo immune to Drain Punch and Taunt, so only Rage Fist hits. Ape +1 with 2 hits taken = 150 BP super-effective, likely KO. Stay in and attack. Keep own Dragonite Multiscale intact to handle Mega Dragonite, Rotom 76% to wall later.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Evaluating type matchups and move effectiveness to choose between Rage Fist and Drain Punch.Assessing Rage Fist damage against Gholdengo given accumulated hits and type matchup.

decisions.thought: Plan: Send Dragonite with Multiscale intact to tank Gholdengo Shadow Ball and hit back super-effective EQ. Keep Rotom 76% healthy to wall Mega Dragonite EQ later. Setup DD if safe.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Evaluating Dragonite versus Rotomwash against Gholdengo by weighing type matchups and survivability.Assessing Rotomwash's limited options against Gholdengo due to immunity to status moves.Comparing Dragonite and Rotom-Wash matchups against Gholdengo and weighing Multiscale for setup.

decisions.thought: Plan: Mega Dragonite full Multiscale tanks Gholdengo Shadow Ball. EQ is 2x super-effective, Mega for power to KO. Keep Rotom 76% to wall opposing Mega Dragonite EQ later. Ape fainted.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Evaluating Mega Evolution and move choice by comparing speed, type matchup, and Multiscale damage reduction.Assessing Mega Evolution damage output and sequencing against the opponent's defenses.

decisions.thought: Plan: Gholdengo at 9% can't KO us, free setup. EQ KOs if stays but fails if Dragonite/Rotom switch in immune. DD now then KO next, keep Rotom healthy. Mirror needs boosted ESpeed since EQ immune.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Calculating the optimal move by comparing damage, speed, and opponent switch options.Evaluating type immunity and ability interactions against predicted opponent switches.Comparing Dragon Dance setup safety against Earthquake and ExtremeSpeed given switch timing and type matchups.Evaluating Dragon Dance setup versus immediate Earthquake given mirror matchup and priority interactions.

decisions.thought: Plan: +1+1 Mega Dnite vs mirror full Multiscale. EQ useless vs active, ESpeed immune vs Gholdengo/Ape. DD to +2 safe vs switch, then ESpeed race (we move first). Keep Rotom 76% to wall EQ/ESpeed and burn. Opp only ESpeed hits us.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Evaluating speed tiers and move options for a +1 Mega Dragonite mirror matchup with Multiscale and team composition.Assessing damage against Multiscale and resolving the ExtremeSpeed versus Earthquake choice.Evaluating Roost's Flying-type removal risk against Earthquake and comparing it to switching to Rotom-Wash for a burn.Assessing ExtremeSpeed immunity from Ghost types and comparing Dragon Dance versus switching to Rotom-Wash.Evaluating Dragon Dance versus attacking or Roosting to break Multiscale and win the priority race.Analyzing Ghost-type switch risk against ExtremeSpeed and favoring Dragon Dance to preserve momentum.

decisions.thought: Plan: Keep +2+2 Mega Dnite, Roost now to survive ESpeed race. EQ useless vs flying, ESpeed immune vs Gholdengo/Ape. Roost heals then ESpeed x3 breaks multiscale and KOs mirror moving first. Rotom 76% walls EQ/ESpeed later. Opp Gholdengo 9%.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Calculating damage ranges for Mega Dragonite Extreme Speed against Multiscale at full HP with +2 attack.Evaluating Roost healing and damage race outcomes against Multiscale.Assessing priority move order and type-change timing to evaluate Roost versus Earthquake and switch options.Evaluating Rotom as a safe switch to absorb attacks and break Multiscale before re-engaging.Comparing staying to Roost for Multiscale recovery against switching and losing boosts.Evaluating Roost followed by three Extreme Speeds as the line that secures the KO while surviving.

decisions.thought: Plan: Stay +2+2 Mega Dnite, win ESpeed priority race moving first. Break multiscale now, KO in 2-3 hits. Roost loses to priority so attack. Keep Rotom 76% to wall EQ and burn. Opp Gholdengo 9% blocks ESpeed immune, then EQ next.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Evaluating a speed tie and priority interaction to decide the next single move under a 60-word note limit.Assessing Roost to restore multiscale versus attacking in the damage race under the move limit.

decisions.thought: Plan: Stay +2+2 Mega Dnite, win ESpeed priority moving first. First ESpeed was halved by multiscale (100% to 73%), next hits do ~54% for KO in 2. Survive 52 dmg hits. Opp Gholdengo 9% immune to ESpeed, hit with EQ after. Keep Rotom 76% to wall.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Analyzing damage calculations and turn outcomes to determine the optimal move for Mega Dragonite.Evaluating Roost healing versus priority speed tie and predicted Earthquake risk.Comparing Roost recovery against priority tie damage and opponent Roost likelihood.

decisions.thought: Plan: EQ KO 9% Gholdengo (immune to ESpeed). Stay +2+2, win ESpeed priority vs mirror moving first due to speed boost. Keep Rotom 76% to wall EQ. Opp last unknown.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Executing a turn decision by confirming Earthquake KO on Gholdengo and framing the follow-up against Mega Dragonite.

decisions.thought: Plan: Stay +2+2 Mega Dnite, win ESpeed priority moving first. Opp EQ immune vs Flying so must ESpeed. Our ESpeed 2HKOs through broken multiscale. Survive one hit at 73 HP. Keep Rotom 76% for unknown last, watch Ghost immune switch.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Analyzing a Pokemon speed tie and priority matchup with broken Multiscale to determine turn order and outcome.Calculating damage ranges and turn order after Multiscale breaks.Confirming immunity and type matchups to rule out Earthquake and justify Extreme Speed.

decisions.thought: Plan: Stay +2+2, win ESpeed priority first due to speed. ESpeed now drops 66% to ~9%, survive hit 73 to ~21, then KO next. Keep Rotom 76% for unknown last, watch Ghost immune switch.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Calculating damage and KO probability for Mega Dragonite matchup under abstract output constraints.Evaluating Dragon Dance versus Extreme Speed sequencing for the Mega Dragonite matchup.Comparing ESpeed sequencing against Roost and potential Ghost-type switch-ins for the matchup.

decisions.thought: Plan: Keep +2+2 Mega Dnite spamming ESpeed first each turn. ESpeed does ~52%, survives one return hit. Opp roost loop loses in 2-3 hits. Third not Ghost-immune else they'd have switched like Gholdengo did. Keep Rotom 76% for last.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Calculating damage and speed tie for ExtremeSpeed to determine if KO is guaranteed before Roost.Extending the turn simulation to cover the follow-up ExtremeSpeed after a possible Roost.Evaluating the two-turn ESpeed sequence against a potential Roost and the remaining opponent team.Assessing a Ghost-type switch risk versus the current ESpeed line and the Earthquake coverage tradeoff.

decisions.thought: Plan: Stay +2+2 Mega Dnite, ESpeed first via speed tie win. Does ~52-57%, opp at 55% so KO or leave ~3%. Survive return ~50 dmg from 73 HP. Finish next turn if needed. Keep Rotom 76% for last unknown.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Calculating priority and speed to confirm turn order and estimating damage from Extreme Speed under abstract output constraints.Computing damage ranges from Extreme Speed hits and factoring Multiscale status for the KO threshold.

decisions.thought: Plan: Opp Kingambit fresh with Supreme +20%, likely Sucker Punch beats our Earthquake. Don't risk +2 Dnite dying for nothing. Pivot Rotom 76% to absorb Steel/Dark, scout, then Will-O-Wisp to cripple. Keep Dnite 73 HP to revenge later.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Evaluating damage calculation for Mega Dragonite's Earthquake against Kingambit under stat and type modifiers.Estimating damage ranges and priority interactions for the KO probability.Comparing Earthquake’s KO chance against Sucker Punch priority risk versus switching to Rotom as a safer scout.Evaluating Roost to block Sucker Punch versus switching to Rotom to burn Kingambit.

decisions.thought: Plan: Rotom likely dies to Kowtow (~85 dmg). Trade it for burn to halve Kingambit Supreme-boosted attack. Then Mega Dnite EQs for super-effective KO. Burn better than para since Dnite already outspeeds 152 vs max 112, but fears Sucker Punch priority.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Calculating damage ranges and move options to decide Rotom's action against Kingambit.Evaluating Volt Switch to pivot to Dragonite while weighing speed and KO risk.

decisions.thought: Plan: Only burned Kingambit left, KO it to win. Rotom Hydro Pump ~40% + burn chip, 2 hits KO. Keep Mega Dnite 73 HP with EQ to finish if Rotom falls. TWave/Wisp useless vs burn. Rotom survives one burned Kowtow/Sucker.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Analyzing battle state and recalculating Dragonite's stats and Kingambit's attack modifier after a switch.Calculating damage ranges and burn chip to compare Volt Switch, Hydro Pump, and switching to Dragonite.Evaluating Hydro Pump versus Earthquake damage and Sucker Punch priority against the remaining Kingambit.

decisions.thought: Plan: Only burned Kingambit 46% left. Rotom 29 HP dies to any Sucker/Kowtow priority, Hydro risks miss. Switch Mega Dnite 73 HP +2 to tank burned hit, then Earthquake KO for win.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Evaluating Hydro Pump damage and burn chip versus accuracy risk to decide the move.Comparing neutral Electric and Water damage against switching to a +2 Dragonite for a guaranteed OHKO.

decisions.thought: Plan: Only burned Kingambit 40% left. Our EQ is super-effective and full power since burn halves its attack, not ours, so KO. Survive its burned Sucker/Kowtow at 73 HP.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Calculating damage and boost state to decide if Earthquake KOs the weakened opponent.Reevaluating damage under burn to confirm Earthquake cannot KO the opponent.
